verses.text: A Psalm of David. Ascribe to the LORD, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

xrefs.text: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
Then I looked, and I heard the voices of many angels encircling the throne, and the living creatures and the elders. And their number was myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands.
Give glory to the LORD your God before He brings darkness, before your feet stumble on the dusky mountains. You wait for light, but He turns it into deep gloom and thick darkness.
Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
For the nation or kingdom that will not serve you will perish; it will be utterly destroyed.

verses.text: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.

xrefs.text: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and enter His courts.
Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

Then Jehoshaphat consulted with the people and appointed those who would sing to the LORD and praise the splendor of His holiness. As they went out before the army, they were singing: “Give thanks to the LORD, for His loving devotion endures forever.”
One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.
Your people shall be willing on Your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, to You belongs the dew of Your youth.

verses.text: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is heard over many waters.

xrefs.text: Listen closely to the thunder of His voice and the rumbling that comes from His mouth.
The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.
Then Moses departed from Pharaoh, went out of the city, and spread out his hands to the LORD. The thunder and hail ceased, and the rain no longer poured down on the land.
The waters saw You, O God; the waters saw You and swirled; even the depths were shaken.
The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded— hailstones and coals of fire.

verses.text: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.

xrefs.text: The sound of the wings of the cherubim could be heard as far as the outer court, like the voice of God Almighty when He speaks.
For He spoke, and it came to be; He commanded, and it stood firm.
All the people were overcome with amazement and asked one another, “What is this message? With authority and power He commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!
The LORD made the earth by His power; He established the world by His wisdom and stretched out the heavens by His understanding.
to Him who rides upon the highest heavens of old; behold, His mighty voice resounds.

verses.text: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.

xrefs.text: against all the cedars of Lebanon, lofty and lifted up, against all the oaks of Bashan,
But the thornbush replied, ‘If you really are anointing me as king over you, come and find refuge in my shade. But if not, may fire come out of the thornbush and consume the cedars of Lebanon.’
The trees of the LORD have their fill, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,

verses.text: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.

xrefs.text: which the Sidonians call Sirion but the Amorites call Senir—
God brought them out of Egypt with strength like a wild ox.
the mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.
He stood and measured the earth; He looked and startled the nations; the ancient mountains crumbled; the perpetual hills collapsed. His ways are everlasting.
But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; with fine oil I have been anointed.

verses.text: The voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire.

xrefs.text: Your thunder resounded in the whirlwind; the lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.
Part Your heavens, O LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, that they may smoke.
So fire came out from the presence of the LORD and consumed them, and they died in the presence of the LORD.
So Moses stretched out his staff toward heaven, and the LORD sent thunder and hail, and lightning struck the earth. So the LORD rained down hail upon the land of Egypt.
He unleashes His lightning beneath the whole sky and sends it to the ends of the earth.

verses.text: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.

xrefs.text: and they went back to Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of Israel in the Wilderness of Paran at Kadesh. They brought back a report for the whole congregation and showed them the fruit of the land.
though their waters roar and foam and the mountains quake in the surge. Selah
He shakes the earth from its place, so that its foundations tremble.
Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken from its place at the wrath of the LORD of Hosts on the day of His burning anger.
Then the earth shook and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.

verses.text: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”

xrefs.text: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas,
[“]Do you know when mountain goats give birth? Have you watched the doe bear her fawn?
Within Your temple, O God, we contemplate Your loving devotion.
O LORD, I love the house where You dwell, the place where Your glory resides.
“Son of man, set your face toward the south, preach against it, and prophesy against the forest of the Negev.

verses.text: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.

xrefs.text: Now to the King eternal, immortal, and invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
And behold, I will bring floodwaters upon the earth to destroy every creature under the heavens that has the breath of life. Everything on the earth will perish.
The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations perish from His land.
Overwhelmed with fear, they asked one another, “Who is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?
But God remembered Noah and all the animals and livestock that were with him in the ark. And God sent a wind over the earth, and the waters began to subside.

verses.text: The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.

xrefs.text: But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.
‘May the LORD bless you and keep you;
Now may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.
Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.
I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!
